'''Megalodon''' sharks are colossal [[extinction|extinct]] [[aquatic]] [[creatures]] from the [[wikipedia:Cenozoic|Cenozoic]] era. They are among the [[List_of_creatures_by_adult_size|largest creatures in the game]], with their adult size being slightly smaller than [[dragon]]s and the [[giant rhinoceros]]. Given their size, they can [[butcher|butchered]] for extremely large amounts of meat. They are found in [[savage]] waters.

Some [[dwarf|dwarves]] [[like]] megalodon sharks for their ''great size''.
